summary: The current official TKGM Parsel Sorgu viewer/API returned one safe Siverek parcel polygon for the unchanged WUP point. Exact-point and administrative lookups agreed on native identity Camikebir-236/3 and matching geometry.
custodian: TKGM is the evidenced national source authority. A separate Siverek local registry/cadastre service was not independently evidenced, so registryFound remains null.
requests: English and Turkish discovery, official viewer HTML/JavaScript/config inspection, public province and neighborhood list requests, exact-point parcel GET, and administrative parcel GET are recorded in the city record. No credentials, unsafe fields, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass, or TLS disable was used.

schemaAndCrs.geometryCrs: EPSG:4326 inferred; explicit CRS was absent
schemaAndCrs.compositeKeyProvenance: Camikebir-236/3 is the official ozet value and is corroborated by the official component fields.

One exact-point hit is not evidence of citywide or countrywide completeness.
